ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the title in the figure is “Yellow River Delta High-efficiency Ecological Economic Zone,” showing the Yellow River Delta area in northern Shandong, with the region near sea areas such as the Bohai Sea and Laizhou Bay, belonging to the estuarine delta area along the coast of the Yellow River's entrance into the sea. Then reason: the question stem emphasizes that this economic zone is an “ecologically highly sensitive area” and asks about an “ecological tourism industry.” Combined with industry types, port logistics, reclaiming wasteland to grow grain, petrochemicals, creative culture, etc. are not directly ecological tourism industries; the only one that fits “ecological tourism” is the ecotourism industry. Therefore the answer is the ecotourism industry.
